title: Purposive action can occur without consciousness or volition

statements.text: Following Descartes, coordinated and purposive actions can take place in humans without consciousness or volition, or against volition, as reflexes show. If actions of some complexity come from mere mechanism, actions of greater complexity may come from a more refined mechanism.

sources.quote: He starts from reflex action in man, from the unquestionable fact that, in ourselves, co-ordinate, purposive, actions may take place, without the intervention of consciousness or volition, or even contrary to the latter.
